facts.text: Jolene designed notebooks with elements like galaxies and circuitry, inspired by her love for space and engines.

evidence.quote: I was inspired by my love for space and engines, so I designed these notebooks with elements like galaxies and circuitry. I think they turned out really cool!

facts.text: Jolene's notebooks give Deborah a sense of excitement and admiration for her creativity.

evidence.quote: You have such a knack for turning these into art. They make me feel excited just by looking at them. Your creativity is amazing!

facts.text: Jolene believes that seeing art and design in various things provides her with a unique perspective on problems.

evidence.quote: Seeing art and design in various things gives me a unique perspective on problems.
